messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up — planning AWS KMS roll for Redwood Private (control-plane + data-plane). Need to align on envelope strategy, DEK caching TTLs, and rotation orchestration. Targeting next Tuesday maintenance window. :calendar:

devon: timeline + blast radius? will this touch existing private customers or just new deployments?

olivia: existing customers with Private will need rewrap; plan is non-blocking: rolling rewrap via background job that re-encrypts DEKs to new CMK, fallback to old CMK allowed. No data-plane downtime expected. Want approval for grant pattern & CMK policy.

ravi: prefer rotation scheme: KEK per-tenant? or single account CMK with key policy restricting ops? pros/cons?

alex: for Private we used a hybrid: control-plane KEK (account-level CMK) + per-tenant DEKs (envelope). Keeps number of CMKs low but enforces tenant isolation via IAM and audit logs. Should we enforce separate CMK for very high-reg customers?

devon: what about grant usage for the control-plane role that runs rewrap workers? how do we revoke mid-rotation if we detect fail?

olivia: rewrap worker will use short-lived grants with grant tokens, and we keep a rotation state in DB. If abort, we stop issuing new grants. revoke API isn't immediate for AWS grants; we rely on grant IDs + rotation state to stop usage. Also plan to rotate by creating a new CMK alias and updating control-plane to prefer new CMK while honoring previous until rewrap completes.

keyops-bot: example re-encrypt command to test rewrap locally:
```
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://enc-dek.bin --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/NEW-KEY-ID --source-encryption-context '"tenant":"tenant-123"'
```
Remember to include encryption-context during re-encrypt for context binding.

security-bot: make sure CloudTrail trails for KMS are enabled in customer VPC account (or pushed logs if onprem). Also enable KMS key rotation flag and keep a record in audit-log-s3. We need cross-account CloudTrail visibility for Dedicated/customers.

ravi: DEK cache TTL? suggestions: small TTL for high-security (5m), larger TTL for latency-sensitive (30m). We should make it configurable per-customer and expose via Console.

alex: edge-case: if control-plane loses access to CMK (policy change) mid-rotation, rewrap jobs will fail; add a 'degraded-mode' that serves using existing DEKs and queues rewrap retries. Also add alerts when rewrap fallbacks > 1% for > 15m.

devon: RBAC: update iam role docs? who signs off? security + infra to sign.

olivia: proposed checklist (short):
- create new CMK with strict key policy
- grant rewrap-worker role temporary grants
- enable KMS key rotation and alias swap plan
- run staged rewrap on canary tenant (small dataset)
- monitor CloudTrail + console metrics + rewrap errors
- cutover alias and retire old CMK after verification
I'll paste the checklist in GH PR.

ravi: approve checklist, add a step for automated audit export to S3 with lifecycle 30d then archive. also include KMS key description with contact/purpose.

alex: add script for simulated rewrap for perf testing. we'll run in staging. :white_check_mark:

olivia: thanks. tagging @devon @ravi @alex for final sign-off. I'll open RFC and schedule the window.
